Ferran Torres' Winning Goal Secures World Cup for Spain

Ferran Torres scored the winning goal in extra time to secure a 1-0 victory over Argentina and win the FIFA World Cup for Spain. The goal, which was assisted by Nico Williams, came in the 106th minute of extra time and proved decisive in the match. This marked Spain's first World Cup title since 2010.
